name: Δήμος Αθηναίων
note: No protocol e-mail found on cityofathens.gr. The Τμήμα Πρωτοκόλλου, Διεκπεραίωσης & Αρχείου (Πατησίων 159) exists, but no address is published for it. The municipality uses the @athens.gr domain (e.g. gd.dioikisis@athens.gr for the General Director of Administration on the page above). There is no e-protocol form, only rantevou.cityofathens.gr and webapp.novoville.com.

name: Δήμος Πειραιά
note: Listed for the Τμήμα Πρωτοκόλλου και Γενικού Αρχείου, Δραγάτση 12, 1ος όροφος, tel. 2132022012. The same address appears under ΣΤΟΙΧΕΙΑ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΣ at https://www.piraeus.gov.gr/home.

name: Δήμος Περιστερίου
note: No e-mail on the contact page or on /ypiresies/, only phone 210-5701000 and Πλ. Δημοκρατίας 1. That page refers to a PDF contact directory (upd. 2026), which was not found. Online channels: https://aitiseis.peristeri.gr/sadp/ (certificates) and https://digital.peristeri.gr (Αιτήματα, TAXISnet login).

name: Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης
note: This is the general info@ address. A Sept 2025 AADE (government) notice lists it as the contact for 'Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης, Δ/νση Αστικής Κατάστασης, Τμήμα Γενικού Πρωτοκόλλου και Διοικητικής Υποστήριξης'. It was not found as plain text on thessaloniki.gr itself. Online channels: https://politis.thessaloniki.gr/ and https://imc.thessaloniki.gr/imc.

name: Δήμος Καλαμαριάς
note: Official phone and e-mail directory PDF linked from the kalamaria.gr contact page, entry 'Γραφείο Πρωτοκόλλου' (p.3). The Greek label text is encoding-garbled in extraction, but its structure and the address match. A separate building-permits protocol exists: protokpoleodomias@kalamaria.gr. E-services: https://eservices.kalamaria.gr/

name: Δήμος Λαυρεωτικής
note: No e-mail on the official contact page or homepage. Recruitment notices mention submission 'στο Γραφείο πρωτοκόλλου ή ηλεκτρονικά στο e-mail', but the address is obfuscated in every copy found. Domains in use: lavreotiki.gr and lavrio.gr. E-services: https://dimotis.lavreotiki.gr/

name: Δήμος Δράμας
note: General contact address on the official contact page and in the site footer. The page has a full staff e-mail list but no protocol-specific address.

name: Δήμος Καστοριάς
note: Labelled 'Κεντρικό Πρωτόκολλο' in the Επικοινωνία section of the official homepage (tel. 2467351100). Online requests: https://aitimata.kastoria.gov.gr/ and https://kastoria.gov.gr/eserv/

name: Δήμος Καρδίτσας
note: Τμήμα Πρωτοκόλλου και Επικοινωνίας με τους πολίτες (tel. 24413 50727) lists 'municipality@dimoskarditsas.gov.gr, protokolo@dimoskarditsas.gov.gr'. municipality@dimoskarditsas.gov.gr is the general address (Δημαρχείο). The official site is dimoskarditsas.gov.gr; karditsa.gr refused connection.

name: Δήμος Τρίπολης
note: The only e-mail under 'Στοιχεία Επικοινωνίας' on the official contact page. It is built by JavaScript (dropALine('dimos','tripolis.gr')). No protocol-specific address is published.

name: Δήμος Σύρου-Ερμούπολης
note: Listed as 'Γραφείο Πρωτοκόλλου' in the official service directory (Διοικητικές Υπηρεσίες). It is also the general municipal address. There is a request form at https://www.syros-ermoupolis.gr/request-form/

name: Δήμος Ρεθύμνης
note: The contact page labels this address 'Γραφείο Δημάρχου'. The page names a 'Γραφείο Κεντρικού Πρωτοκόλλου' but gives no e-mail for it. Electronic requests (e-αιτήματα): https://www.rethymno.gr/e-services/e-requests

name: Δήμος Ζαγορίου
note: Official municipal letterhead (Oct 2021 notice) on zagori.gov.gr gives 'Email:d.zagoriou@zagori.gr'. Third-party copies label it the Mayor's office/general address, and a 2022 document repeats it. zagori.gov.gr returned only partial content and zagori.gr refused connection, so no current contact page was confirmed. Older form: d.zagoriou@1376.syzefxis.gov.gr.

name: Δήμος Καλαβρύτων
note: General address on the official contact-form page, alongside dimos.kalavriton@1363.syzefxis.gov.gr. The phone directory (https://www.kalavrita.gr/epikoinwnia/phonesinfo) has a 'Πρωτόκολλο' entry (tel. 26923-60429, fax 26923-60433), but its e-mail is hidden by spam cloaking.
